title: ARIA Gateway Policy Contract
description: Versioned policy contract for identity input, effective access, and governance decisions. Version 1.0.0.

PolicyContractVersion.description: Contract schema version. Must equal '1.0.0' for this schema.

IdentityProvider.description: Identity provider slug. Well-known values are listed as examples; any string is valid for custom IDPs.

SensitivityTier.description: Ordered sensitivity classification tier. public < internal < confidential < highly_confidential.

NormalizedIdentity.title: NormalizedIdentity
NormalizedIdentity.description: Authenticated principal as resolved from an upstream identity provider, normalised to IDP-agnostic fields.

principal_id.description: Immutable principal identifier. Maps to the OIDC 'sub' claim or the provider's object/user ID.

groups.description: Group memberships expressed as stable identifiers (AAD group IDs, GitHub team slugs, etc.).

roles.description: Application roles and/or OAuth scopes granted to this principal (union of 'roles' and 'scp' claims).

tenant.description: Tenant or organization identifier (AAD tenant ID, GitHub org slug, etc.). Optional for single-tenant deployments.

extensions.description: Arbitrary IDP-specific claims with no canonical mapping. Keys should be namespaced (e.g. 'entra:employee_id').

EffectiveAccessContext.title: EffectiveAccessContext
EffectiveAccessContext.description: Effective access context derived from an authenticated identity and the gateway's policy engine.

consumer_id.description: Consumer team / application identifier. Matches 'allowed_consumers' in OASF governance overlays.

sensitivity_ceiling.description: Maximum sensitivity tier this consumer is cleared to access.

purview_roles.description: Fine-grained purview roles controlling cross-cutting governance decisions. An empty array means no elevated purview.

identity.description: Originating normalized identity (if available). Absent for header-only or anonymous requests.

PolicyDecision.title: PolicyDecision
PolicyDecision.description: Result of a governance policy evaluation for a single asset and consumer pair.

allowed.description: true if the consumer is permitted to access the asset.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why access was denied. Always set when 'allowed' is false.

approval_chain.description: Ordered list of approver identifiers that must grant access before the consumer can proceed.

action_url.description: URL the consumer can visit to submit an access request.
